The deprecated strike tag renders as strikethrough

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><strike>gone</strike></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
